spreadCalibration.productionRule: Independent 3.0+ model-vs-market points = high-priority audit/research, not automatic bet; 1.5-2.5 = watch/research.

marketAwareProduction.productionRule: Primary predictive spread = 80% current market + 20% independent football line. Preserve independent line separately for edge research and explainability.

uncertaintyCalibration.productionRule: Display empirical uncertainty and do not upgrade a recommendation solely because independent-model disagreement is large.

qbCalibration.productionRule: Apply only expected-current-QB value minus the QB value already embedded in the baseline, then scale for participation/health/scenario probability.

offenseDefenseWeighting.productionRule: No generic offense-over-defense or defense-over-offense tilt; unequal weights worsened historical early-season MAE.

rosterContinuity.reason: Historical nflverse roster/snap-count identity joins produced implausible zero continuity even after GSIS preference; no continuity point values are permitted from this path.

v2.rule: Not promoted because passing coefficient had counterintuitive sign.

v3.rule: Position-group matchup diagnostics contribute 0.0 production points.

inSeasonPriorDecay.method: walk-forward scoring-margin blend; each historical week uses only prior weeks
inSeasonPriorDecay.note: Use smoothed phase weights rather than noisy single-week optima. Re-run with EPA/player/availability live rating architecture once sufficient historical reconstruction is available.

totalsCalibration.productionRule: Production total = current market total for v1. Independent baseline total remains research context only and contributes 0% until richer QB/pace/weather/OL features demonstrate incremental holdout value over market.

source: nflverse schedule/results/play-by-play/closing-line data; calibration executed in nfl-betting-intelligence GitHub Actions
caveats: Closing-market calibration is a historical benchmark; current prices may move before close.
Current personnel state can block or widen confidence but cannot move points without a validated historical conversion.
QB production value must be expressed as a delta versus baseline-embedded quarterback to avoid double counting.
Position-group matchup diagnostics remain 0-point inputs until an incremental residualized interaction model passes holdout.
Production totals are 100% market-centered until a richer total model proves incremental value.
ATS threshold results are same-sample diagnostics and require prospective 2026 CLV/outcome validation.
